desc: The Strike Industries Extended Magazine Plate for CANiK TP9 was designed to provide smoother magazine reloading through a slow drag / no snag design while maintaining maximum magazine capacity. The Extended Magazine Plate (EMP) adds plus 5 9mm rounds to OEM CANiK TP9 magazines. Following the success of our EMP systems for pistols, the form factor and unique geometric design gives a unified and aggressive aesthetic look to your CANiK TP9.
